name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair Humphrey's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage. His knack for understanding complex systems led him to a degree in mechanical engineering, followed by a stint at a smaller racing team where he honed his skills in operations management. He joined Hitech GP five years ago, bringing a wealth of practical experience and a reputation for meticulous planning.

Alistair believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member's input is valued. He focuses on optimizing processes and resource allocation to ensure smooth race weekend execution. His hands-on approach and ability to anticipate potential challenges have been instrumental in Hitech GP's recent successes.

What sets Alistair apart is his innovative approach to logistics and team coordination. He is constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to improve efficiency and performance, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a slightly weathered face and a kind smile.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out engineering notebook.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a pre-race team huddle, regardless of the schedule.
